subject: cli: add the bounded Gateway query command
scope: oo query on the bound archive only. Conversation, Gateway, PostgreSQL, sandbox, supply, dual-arch, and release stay unsigned.
decision_scope: CLI query child. Withheld because a peerless FIFO blocks in open before the regular-file check.

dependency_delta.lock_diff: six names added under package oo-cli: libc, rustls, serde, serde_json, tokio, tokio-rustls

probe_attempt_4.cause: probe panicked after save because 3 cases failed

findings.expected: A non-regular token, SQL, or CA path is rejected without waiting for a peer, before token bytes are read and before a socket. Token exits 4 with token file rejected: not-file. SQL and CA exit 1 with not-file.
findings.actual: open uses O_NOFOLLOW and does not set O_NONBLOCK. Peerless token, SQL, and CA FIFOs were still blocked at the 1200ms deadline. The harness sent SIGKILL (signal 9). Stdout and stderr were empty. HTTP hits were 0. Elapsed 1210ms, 1202ms, and 1210ms. The same paths return not-file in about 15ms once a writer has opened the FIFO. Sandbox and pre-open usage do not block.
findings.reproduction: mkfifo /tmp/oo-a103-token.fifo && oo query --auth external --token-file /tmp/oo-a103-token.fifo --gateway http://127.0.0.1:9/ --transport local-development --json 'select 1'. The process does not exit. Repeat with -f and --ca-file on a FIFO that has no writer.

observations: Parent symlink is followed (exit 0, one hit). Hard link of a 0600 token is accepted (exit 0, one hit). The contract lists both as outside the final-component check.
foreign_uid is unverified. chown to 65534 returned EPERM under cap-drop ALL.
ACL, same-owner rewrite after the read, and zeroization were not tested. The source drops the token String.
The 16 MiB render cap was not reached. The HTTP cap is 1 MiB and the length check follows allocation of the full markdown string.
HTTP disconnect was not treated as backend cancellation. No PostgreSQL session was opened.
The owner-probe name was absent after reap. The poll did not observe the inode. An O_EXCL collision was not provoked. Unwritable TMPDIR fails closed.
Slash, HTML, and Markdown links are not escaped. Pipes, backticks, CR, LF, tab, and the documented C0/C1/bidi set are escaped. A cell did not forge a footer line.
A non-UTF-8 argument before --json selects the text usage error. --json before that argument selects one JSON usage document. Both exit 2 with no socket.

Reflected gateway text exited 2 at one hit. Raw stdout lacked the token, the SQL marker, 127.0.0.1, and 'Bearer '. The stored message is leak [redacted] and [redacted] at [redacted] [redacted], hint fix.
